plugin.description:
TEMPORARY test build of zbee/ARC PR #3 (ipc-venture-work): adds ARC.AddItem / ARC.GetInProgress / ARC.GetListCount IPC used by LazyCrafter's ArcDispatch. Installs alongside your normal production ARControl (different InternalName, no config or IPC collision at rest) for in-game verification only. Pre-seeded with a copy of your existing ARControl venture setup so no re-setup is needed. Not maintained; remove after testing is done.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dajoey/lalalazy/main/pluginmaster.json

website.description: ARControl, by Liza, now maintained by zbee. Will be merged into AutoRetainer, at which point it will (probably) no longer be maintained separately.
website.readmeExcerpt:
# ARC

Instead of manually managing retainer plans for each individual character,
which can get fairly tedious fairly quickly, we optimize this a bit and
only manage "high-level" plans.

This means we create a list a la:

- 5000 Cobalt Ore
- 2000 Gold Ore

... and ARC distributes each venture automatically amongst all characters
which are included.
website.title: ARC

variant.changelog:
v8.6.0 (2026-09-11)

Test build of zbee/ARC PR#3 (github.com/zbee/ARC/pull/3, branch dajoey/ARC ipc-venture-work). Adds an IPC surface (ARC.AddItem, ARC.GetInProgress, ARC.GetListCount) for other plugins to hand off venture work - LazyCrafter's ArcDispatch uses it when present, falling back to reflection otherwise. Not for general use; installed alongside production ARControl to verify the PR in-game before replying to the maintainer.
